data.long_meaning: Mlm is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mal' meaning mountain. This name signifies strength, courage and vitality. It is believed to be auspicious for those who wish to overcome challenges and achieve great heights. The name Mlm carries the meaning “Mountain, powerful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Mlm usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mlm is a sacred name in Hinduism, symbolizing the strength and courage of the divine mountain Shiva. It is believed that invoking this name can help one overcome obstacles and attain spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Mlm belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain, powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mlm total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
